notes.title: User Interface Input Update & Graphics Polishing
notes.notes:
We take up some issues mentioned in the Early Access road map and changed the legacy gaze input based input system into a more intuitive controller based laser pointer menu navigation. 

The ingame scenes got a polish due to lighting updates and improved shading, so that they appear more realistic. The cover image contains the lightning before the update on the left side and after the update on the right side, so you can see the difference. 

A fix for a rare occurring ship staggering after restart ingame is also delivered. Have a look at the details:

User interface improvements

 The legacy gaze pointer has been replaced with a controller based laserpointer.
 Visualizing VR controllers, which implies updated controller bindings
 Better contrasting hover and press of the menubuttons against the background

Graphical ingame improvements

 Higher resolution skyboxes and textures
 Updated shaders for better lighting and reflections of the respective material
 More intensive direct lights, lightmaps updated
 normal maps adjustments, e.g. the ships surfaces are defined less bumpy
 Planet Earth is now visible in the titlescreen to the left, rearranged ships

Misc.

 Fixed: Sometimes staggering after restart at last gate

notes.title: Extended Controls Update - Ver. 1.0.0-1924-beta
notes.notes:
If you are having issues with tangling cables while flying, the new extended steering controls will eliminate the need to turn your head during flight. Furthermore, you can now recenter your view at any time in the game.

Details

Slope Steering

 Slope Steering is now available in race and in the track builder (recommended for corded headsets)
 Optionally it can be switched off via the settings menu, but it is enabled by default
 Saves the setting in the player preferences

Recenter View

 Recenter View is usable at any time via controller button, in game and in track builder
 Also Automatic Recenter View when switching to main menu, at race start and at continue in game 
 Default controller bindings for Recenter View created 

Misc.

 Default HP Motion Controller bindings created
 How To Play page updated

notes.title: Wrangling cords issue - Getting fixed with the next update!
notes.notes:
Not all pilots have their cords mounted overhead.
So if you experience problems while racing with wrangling cords:
We are working on an extended control setup which specifically addresses this issue and should fix it.
It comes with our next update, which should be available mid-april.
And the Demo version will get the update as well.
